Your sneaker ad footage is ready. I couldn't add the captions, though, so this video has no text yet.

**Download links** (they expire in about 24 hours):
- Video (15 s, 9:16 at 496×826, silent): https://videos.magichour.ai/cmwbi9dl50231hb01xk6wrliv/output.mp4?X-Goog-Algorithm=GOOG4-RSA-SHA256&X-Goog-Credential=web-service%40magic-hour-385504.iam.gserviceaccount.com%2F20261111%2Fauto%2Fstorage%2Fgoog4_request&X-Goog-Date=20261111T023438Z&X-Goog-Expires=86400&X-Goog-SignedHeaders=host&X-Goog-
- Sneaker photo (plain white leather low-top, white laces, white sole, no logo): https://videos.magichour.ai/cmwbi8zuy04q0gq01sirkoosg/output.png?X-Goog-Algorithm=GOOG4-RSA-SHA256&X-Goog-Credential=web-service%40magic-hour-385504.iam.gserviceaccount.com%2F20261111%2Fauto%2Fstorage%2Fgoog4_request&X-Goog-Date=20261111T023349Z&X-Goog-Expires=86400&X-Goog-SignedHeaders=host&X-Goog-

**What I made:**
- I generated the sneaker photo, then turned it into one 15-second clip. I asked for three moves: a slow orbit (0–5 s), a close push-in on the laces and toe (5–10 s), and a pull-back to the whole shoe (10–15 s).
- The AI follows shot directions loosely, and I couldn't play the result here. The three moves may blend into each other instead of reading as clean cuts. Please check it.
- It cost 365 credits: 5 for the photo and 360 for the video.

**Why there are no captions:**
- None of my tools can place your own text on a video at fixed positions. The subtitle tool only writes captions from speech it hears, and this video is silent.
- I could ask the video AI to draw the words itself, but it often misspells text and puts it wherever it likes. It could not reliably keep your 15% side and 20% top/bottom margins, so I left the footage clean.

**The safe way to add them yourself:** use any video editor (CapCut, Premiere, iMovie, etc.) with these settings:
- 0–5 s: "Meet your everyday pair"
- 5–10 s: "Clean look. Easy style."
- 10–15 s: "Shop now"
- For this 496×826 frame, keep each caption's full text box inside x 75–421 px and y 166–660 px (the middle 70% of the width and 60% of the height).

Or, if you'd like me to try having the AI draw the captions anyway, knowing the wording and position may come out wrong, just say so.
